description: Transform any wall into a massive cinema screen with the Zebronics Pixaplay 62 Android Smart LED Projector. Featuring Full HD 1080P resolution and an impressive 3000 lumens brightness, this projector delivers vivid, sharp visuals on screens up to 304 inches in size, making it perfect for home entertainment, presentations, or movie nights. The built-in Android operating system gives you direct access to popular streaming platforms like Netflix, YouTube, and Amazon Prime Video, so you can enjoy your favourite content without any additional devices. Connectivity is seamless with built-in WiFi, Screen Mirroring, Miracast, and iOS Screen Mirroring support, allowing you to cast content effortlessly from your smartphone or tablet. The integrated speaker ensures a complete audio-visual experience right out of the box. Its compact, stylish cylindrical design in white with a modern blue accent makes it a tasteful addition to any room. The included remote control lets you navigate menus and adjust settings with ease. Whether you are setting up a home theatre or need a portable projection solution, the Zebronics Pixaplay 62 is a versatile and feature-rich choice.
